cost.details: An ally in Range 8 is attacked by a Ranged weapon

system.description:
(INT/Safe Rest) Reaction: When an ally in Range 8 is attacked by a Ranged weapon. The attack has disadvantage. If it misses, you can make a free thrown weapon attack against the attacker if they are in Range of you.

[A] The INT/Safe Rest uses are a counter on this feature, tracked on the sheet (click the counter to correct mistakes); using the feature spends one, and your Reaction's action.

[A] Target the attacker, then use this feature: its next attack is rolled with disadvantage (a mark on it, removed by that attack). If that attack misses, a card offers you a free thrown weapon attack against it.

[M] Use it only when a Ranged weapon attack targets an ally within Range 8 — the mark applies to the attacker's next attack, whatever it is. Whether the attacker is in your weapon's range is yours to judge.
